acceptance_basis: An isolated PEP 517 wheel installed into a fresh non-system-site venv from the exact workstation lock, passed pip check, resolved project modules outside the checkout, and loaded only the authorized external LAMMPS 20260902 module path.
Installed pgworld doctor, P01-06 energy/force/virial, and P01-07 tangent fixtures ran against real LAMMPS and closed every solver instance.
All immutable profile IDs and canonical hashes survived packaging; installed-resource tampering failed closed and biological certification remained false.

Every Git-tracked Python source compiled under Python 3.11, the final integrated suite passed 173 tests with no failures/errors/skips, and an independently reviewed Windows newline-materialization regression was corrected without changing profile content or runtime physics.
The wheel member allowlist excludes private/generated data and the legacy elastic task is default-deny, explicitly forensic, and deletion-safe.
limitations: G1 establishes numerical implementation and packaging consistency under legacy/provisional profiles; it does not approve biological parameters or the unresolved molecular coarse-graining.
LAMMPS 20260902 is supplied by an external Windows installer without Python distribution metadata, so the dependency lock is exact for this workstation rather than a universal binary lock.
No fracture/topology-change gate, production campaign, experiment, trained model, public release, or manuscript/submission approval is established by G1.
The repository still has no tracked LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE file; public distribution rights require owner review.
